title: A hole on a cylinder stays on the cylinder when its radius changes

expect.note: a d6 hole 5 deep, square to the top of an R10 cylinder 40 long: V = pi 100 40 - integral over the drill's disk of (sqrt(R^2 - x^2) - R + 5)

the cylinder grows to R12 (its top to z 27): the hole stays on the face, square to it at the same angle and height, still 5 deep: V = pi 144 40 - integral over the disk of (sqrt(144 - x^2) - 12 + 5) (Gauss-Legendre, 200 points). A hole left where it was would start 2 mm inside the part
